scholarships.title: EAC Scholarship Programme (EACSP) - Two-Year Funded Master's Scholarships, Cohort 4 (Phase II)
scholarships.official_source: Inter-University Council for East Africa (IUCEA), implementing the East African Community and Federal Republic of Germany initiative

eligibility: Be a citizen of any of the eight EAC Partner States (Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, United Republic of Tanzania, Uganda)
Be below 35 years of age at the time of application
Apply to study in an EAC Partner State other than their country of citizenship
Possess a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of Second Class Upper Division, Distinction or equivalent qualification
Have applied for admission to an eligible Master's programme offered by a partner university
Submit a complete scholarship application within the stipulated application period
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of any of the eight EAC Partner States, aged below 35 at the time of application, holding a Bachelor's degree at Second Class Upper Division, Distinction or equivalent, and applying to an eligible Master's programme at a participating university in an EAC Partner State other than their country of citizenship. Applicants must complete the separate online scholarship application in addition to a university admission application.
benefits: One return economy-class air ticket between the scholar's home country and the host country
Full tuition fees payable directly to the host university
EUR 650 lump-sum allowance for study materials
One-time EUR 1,500 study and research allowance
Medical insurance for the duration of the scholarship
Visa or entry fee where payment of an entry pass or student pass is required
Participation in at least one extracurricular event

requirements: Apply for admission to a partner university in an EAC Partner State other than your country of citizenship, indicating your intention to apply for the EAC Scholarship Programme and paying the university application fee where applicable
Complete the separate online EAC Scholarship Application form
Submit all supporting documents in a single zipped PDF folder, with files named using the prescribed document codes
Email the zipped folder to eacsp@iucea.org and scholarships@adroitconsultinternational.com with the prescribed subject line format
Ensure foreign academic qualifications are equated by the host country's national higher-education council or other competent authority before admission
Have non-English transcripts and certificates translated into English by an accredited provider, submitting both originals and copies
documents: E02 Passport photograph in colour of full head and upper shoulders
E03 Proof of university admission application (admission letter, acknowledgement email, receipt or portal screenshot)
E04 Certified true copies of Bachelor's degree certificate and academic transcript
E06 Bank statements for the last six months, where applicable
E24 English language proficiency certificate such as IELTS or TOEFL, where applicable
Financial-need evidence such as E09 recent payslip, E22 tuition arrears or fee balance statements, and E23 university correspondence demonstrating financial hardship
existing.english_requirement: Applications must be submitted in English. Supporting documents in languages other than English must be submitted with both the original and an English translation by an accredited language translation provider. An English language proficiency certificate such as IELTS or TOEFL is an optional supporting document where applicable.
application_method: Review the call and select a programme and university from the published list of 60 eligible Master's programmes
Apply for admission to that university, declaring your intention to apply for the EAC Scholarship Programme and paying any application fee
Complete the online EAC Scholarship Application form, which opened on 20 August 2026
Compile all mandatory supporting documents into one folder, named by the prescribed document codes
Compress the documents into a single zipped PDF folder

Email the folder to eacsp@iucea.org and scholarships@adroitconsultinternational.com using the subject line format '[Applicant Name] - Application for [Master's Programme] at [University] - Phase II EACSP'
existing.selection_notes: Only complete applications for eligible programmes, submitted before the deadline, in English and in accordance with the guidelines, are considered; missing mandatory documents make an application incomplete and ineligible. Only shortlisted applicants are contacted. IUCEA reserves the right to verify any information submitted, and providing false, misleading or incomplete information can lead to automatic disqualification or withdrawal of an award. Female applicants, persons with disabilities and applicants from other disadvantaged backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply, and the programme aims for at least 50% female participation among beneficiaries.
existing.best_fit: Financially disadvantaged EAC nationals under 35 with a Second Class Upper Division or Distinction Bachelor's degree, seeking a two-year Master's in mathematics, engineering, informatics, science, technology or business science at a participating university in a neighbouring EAC country.
existing.notes:
The Cohort 4 window (20 August to 10 September 2026) has closed, so this record is recorded as upcoming/recurring rather than open. The official call states that Phase II commenced in October 2025 and is expected to support at least 280 students across three cohorts, which confirms further cohorts beyond Cohort 4 within this phase, but no next-cohort window is published as of 2026-10-04, so deadline_date is null. The published timeline runs past the closing date: successful students and host universities are to be informed in December 2026, and scholars would begin at the earliest available intake in line with each host university's academic calendar. Applying for university admission does not constitute an application for the scholarship; the separate scholarship application is mandatory.
Funding period: Monthly stipend for the 2-year scholarship period; allowances as one-off payments on arrival
existing.application_period: Cohort 4 ran 20 August to 10 September 2026 and is closed. Phase II of the programme is stated to cover three cohorts from 2025, so a further cohort is expected on the same annual cycle; no next-cohort window was published as of 2026-10-04.
existing.deadline_display: 10 September 2026, 17:00 East Africa Time (Cohort 4 application period: 20 August to 10 September 2026)
